Flip Board XXL: The Strategy Game for Active Dogs Bring variety into your dog's everyday life with the Flip Board XXL. The strategy game is ideal for challenging your furry friend mentally and physically, and to banish boredom from everyday life. Besides, you strengthen the bond with your darling by playing together. The board game consists of cavities that you can fill with snacks of your choice. The lids must then be pushed aside or folded open by your dog. In addition, there are three cones that your four-legged friend has to knock over with her paw or snout to get to the desired rewards. The enclosed instructions explain how you can optimise the training and motivate your dog. After use, you can simply put the intelligence game in the dishwasher, so that it is ready for the next use. By the way - you can find a version of the toy for smaller dogs here: Flip Board
